content: We have functional groups list. For SN2, we want to break alkyl halide (or aryl halide) and form secondary amine (or primary amine). The target molecule has a secondary amine (attached to aromatic carbon). So functional_groups_broken: "alkyl halide". functional_groups_formed: "secondary amines". Also we can specify bonds broken/formed: C-Cl broken, C-N formed. Let's search.
